features.title: 25 Time-Saving Features
features.tagline: Dump, Top 3, focus tools — protect your day
features.why: Dump tasks, pick Top 3, match free minutes, shut down cleanly, and train better time estimates — without planning taking longer than the work.
features.whyHi: दिमाग खाली करो, Top 3 चुनो, खाली समय में सही काम करो, daily shutdown से सुबह आसान बनाओ।
features.useWhen: When you feel busy but not productive, or when planning itself is eating the day.
points: Smart Task Dump — write everything once, get separate planner tasks
Top 3 Today — only three priorities so the list does not overwhelm you
Quick Task Matcher — pick work that fits 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 free minutes
Routine templates, checklists, shutdown and tomorrow-ready flows
Time calculator and estimate trainer to improve planning accuracy
steps: Open More → 25 Time-Saving Features (or this card)
Pick a tool from sections A–E
Use Planner and Focus together with the tools
features.promise: Save hours every week with small, focused tools.

features.title: Planner
features.tagline: Tasks, meetings & day plan for work and life
features.why: Your day stays in one place — work tasks, meetings, errands — so nothing slips and your head stays clear.
features.whyHi: Poora din ek jagah plan karo, kuch bhoolna nahi padega.
features.useWhen: When you plan a workday, meetings, projects or personal to-dos.
points: Quick capture: add a task, note or voice note from a notification or widget
Add tasks, meetings and routines with a time
Repeat daily, Mon-Fri or weekly
Get a reminder with a Mark done button
steps: Open Planner and tap Add
Set title, time and reminder
Tick it off when done

features.title: Focus Timer
features.tagline: Pomodoro cycles, Strict Mode and calm sounds
features.why: One distraction-free block at a time gives you more real work than hours of half attention.
features.whyHi: Phone se door, ek kaam pe poora dhyan.
features.useWhen: When you must finish something important: homework, coding, writing, revision.
points: Pomodoro auto-cycle: 25/5 rounds run by themselves
Strict Mode: a typed phrase makes quitting harder (no app blocking)
Pick 15, 25, 45, 60 min or a custom time
See how much phone time leaked into the session
Play rain, café, white noise or lo-fi (offline) with a sleep timer
Get an alert when the session ends
steps: Open Focus and pick a duration
Press Start and keep the phone down
Review the result when the timer ends
features.promise: One session at a time. One win at a time.

features.title: Habits & XP
features.why: Small daily actions become automatic when you can see your streak growing.
features.whyHi: Roz ki chhoti aadat se badi success, streak aur XP ke saath.
features.useWhen: When you want to build a routine like exercise, reading, water or revision.
points: Daily, weekday or weekly habits
Earn XP and protect your streak
7-day consistency summary
steps: Add a habit and choose its schedule
Tick it each day to earn XP
Check your streak and weekly summary
features.promise: Make progress visible. Make consistency satisfying.

features.title: Goals & deadlines
features.why: Keep projects and exams on track with subjects, deadlines and time logged — for work or study.
features.whyHi: Projects aur deadlines track karo — work ya study dono ke liye.
features.useWhen: When you have deadlines, projects, or exams and want hours + countdown in one place.
points: Add subjects or project areas
Set deadline dates with countdown
Log focused hours against each area
steps: Add your subjects and exam dates
Log every study session
Watch the countdown and plan revisions
features.promise: A calmer route from plan to deadline day.

features.title: Screen-time Insights
features.why: You can only change what you can see. Know exactly where your phone time goes.
features.whyHi: Dekho phone pe time kahan ja raha hai, phir control karo.
features.useWhen: When you feel you use the phone too much, or want a weekly review.
points: Live total and per-app time with seconds
Today, Week and Month reports
Export your last 90 days as CSV
steps: Give Usage access once
Open Insights to see today, week and month
Set a daily goal or per-app limit in Settings
features.promise: Know where your time goes. Choose where it goes next.

features.title: Smart Reminders
features.tagline: The right nudge at the right time
features.why: TIMEORA reminds you, so you do not have to keep checking your phone.
features.whyHi: Sahi waqt pe reminder, bar bar phone kholne ki zarurat nahi.
features.useWhen: When you want alerts for tasks, breaks, screen-time goals, morning report or sleep.
points: One place to switch every alert on or off
Break and goal alerts
Morning report
steps: Open Smart Reminders
Allow notifications if asked
Switch on the alerts you want
features.promise: Helpful reminders. Fewer reasons to open your phone.

features.title: Life Score & Coach
features.tagline: Daily score and what to do next
features.why: One simple score and clear advice tell you what to fix today without any guesswork.
features.whyHi: Ek score aur seedhi salah: aaj kya sudharna hai.
features.useWhen: At the end of the day, or when you are unsure what to improve.
points: Life Score from focus, plan, habits, balance and routine
7-day trend on Home
Rule-based coach tips, fully on your phone
steps: Use planner, focus and habits for a day
Check your score on Home
Open Insights for the coach tips
features.promise: Know your day in one number.

features.title: Friends & Live Rooms
features.why: Working next to a friend, even online, keeps you accountable and makes it more fun.
features.whyHi: Dost ke saath live padho ya kaam karo, motivation badhta hai.
features.useWhen: When you want a study partner, a work-from-home group or a focus challenge.
points: Create a room and share its code
See friends focusing live and the leaderboard
Offline scorecards for challenges
steps: Open Friends & Live Rooms
Create a room and share the code
Press Start focusing and watch the room

features.title: Sleep & Night Routine
features.why: Late-night scrolling steals sleep. A gentle wind-down protects your energy for tomorrow.
features.whyHi: Raat ko phone kam, neend poori, subah fresh.
features.useWhen: If you sleep late, wake up tired or scroll in bed.
points: Bedtime and wake-up reminders
Wind-down alert 15 to 60 min before bed
Restored after reboot
steps: Open Sleep & Night Routine
Set bedtime, wake time and wind-down
Switch it on in Smart Reminders

features.title: App Opening Pause
features.tagline: A short pause before distracting apps
features.why: A few seconds of pause breaks the automatic habit of opening apps without thinking.
features.whyHi: App kholne se pehle ruko aur socho.
features.useWhen: When you open social or video apps without meaning to.
points: 3, 5, 10 or 15 second pause
Choose how often it repeats
Continue or go back Home
steps: Open App Opening Pause
Allow display over other apps
Switch it on and pick a duration
features.promise: Open apps on purpose, not by reflex.

features.title: Weekly Wrapped
features.tagline: Your week as swipeable story cards
features.why: Seeing your week as a story makes your habits easy to understand and fun to share.
features.whyHi: Har hafte apna top app, best din aur bachaya hua time cards mein dekho.
features.useWhen: Every Sunday evening, or any time you want to see how your week went.
points: Your top app and top category
Your most productive day
Time saved vs last week
Share any card as an image
steps: Open Weekly Wrapped
Swipe or tap through the cards
Press Share to send a card
features.promise: Your week, wrapped. Only on your phone until you share it.
